about: Labelled evaluation corpus for the knockout-control reasoning gate (verdict/knockout.py). Constructed test cases modelled on standard antibody-validation reporting language — NOT verbatim from specific papers. Each case names the antibody target to assess and the ground-truth label a specificity reviewer would assign: validated = an in-study GENETIC control (knockout/knockdown/CRISPR/siRNA showing signal loss) for THIS antibody; ambiguous = a validation is claimed/implied but is not an in-study genetic control (bare claim, cited prior validation, peptide competition, overexpression, manufacturer, or a knockout of the WRONG target); not_reported = no specificity validation is described.

cases.label: validated
cases.methods: Sections were stained with anti-TrkB (Cell Signaling, 4603). Antibody specificity was confirmed in TrkB-knockout brain tissue, which showed no immunoreactivity.
cases.rationale: in-study knockout showing loss of signal

cases.label: validated
cases.methods: Specificity of the anti-STIM1 antibody (Sigma, S6072) was verified by siRNA knockdown of STIM1, which abolished the band by western blot.

cases.label: validated
cases.methods: We validated the anti-CD47 antibody using CRISPR/Cas9 CD47-knockout cells, which lost all surface staining by flow cytometry.
cases.rationale: in-study CRISPR knockout, loss of staining

cases.label: validated
cases.methods: anti-ATG7 (Abcam, ab133528) was validated by shRNA-mediated ATG7 knockdown; the band intensity decreased by more than 90%.

cases.label: validated
cases.methods: The anti-GFAP antibody recognized a single band that was absent in GFAP-/- (knockout) tissue.

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.methods: A validated, highly specific anti-Tau antibody was used for immunostaining at 1:1000.
cases.rationale: bare 'validated' claim, no genetic control described

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.methods: anti-alpha-synuclein (BD Biosciences, 610787), previously validated by knockout in an earlier study, was applied overnight.
cases.rationale: validation cited from a prior paper, not performed in this study

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.methods: Specificity of the anti-Substance P antibody was confirmed by peptide competition, in which pre-adsorption with the antigen abolished staining.
cases.rationale: peptide competition is a control but NOT a genetic (knockout/knockdown) control

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.methods: The anti-PD-L1 antibody was validated by the manufacturer for immunohistochemistry.
cases.rationale: manufacturer validation, no in-study genetic control

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.methods: Antibody specificity for anti-Nrf2 was supported by overexpression of Nrf2, which increased the signal intensity.
cases.rationale: gain-of-function overexpression, not a knockout loss-of-function control

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.methods: Specificity of the anti-Kv4.2 antibody was assessed in Kv4.3-knockout mice, in which staining was unchanged.
cases.rationale: a genetic control is described, but it knocks out the WRONG target (Kv4.3, not Kv4.2)

cases.label: not_reported
cases.methods: Sections were stained with anti-Iba1 (FUJIFILM Wako, 019-19741; 1:500) to label microglia.
cases.rationale: antibody named, no validation of any kind described

cases.label: not_reported
cases.methods: Immunostaining used anti-NeuN (Millipore, MAB377) at a dilution of 1:500 overnight at 4C.

cases.label: not_reported
cases.methods: As a control, the primary antibody was omitted, which yielded no signal.
cases.rationale: primary-omission (secondary-only) control does not validate the primary's specificity

cases.label: not_reported
cases.methods: Cells were labelled with anti-CD3 (BioLegend, 300402), anti-CD8 (BioLegend, 300908), and anti-FoxP3 (eBioscience, 14-4776).

cases.label: not_reported
cases.methods: An isotype-matched control antibody was included to assess background staining for the anti-Ki-67 antibody.
cases.rationale: isotype control assesses background, not specificity validation
